title: Tinkering Teacup Tetra
statement: A pea-sized, glass-bodied tetra with a glowing amber belly like a drop of warm tea, she spends her days nudging a chipped porcelain teacup upright on a bed of moss and soft sand, and she hums in tiny bubbles when she succeeds. The tank is lit like a quiet late afternoon, with honey-colored sunbeams, drifting dust motes of plankton, and a few curled ferns.
